purpose: Test whether closed-loop replanning frequency explains part of the performance difference between pi0.5 and SmolVLA.

offset_roles.-5.0: representative condition where pi0.5 showed a confirmed relative advantage
offset_roles.5.0: representative condition where SmolVLA showed a confirmed relative advantage

comparison.note: After the first replan, horizon=10 and horizon=50 consume the seeded noise sequence at different physical times. Therefore the experiment compares the complete closed-loop policies under different replanning horizons, not identical per-frame diffusion or flow noise.

interpretation.if_pi05_improves_at_10: Long open-loop execution is a plausible contributor to the previously observed pi0.5 performance limitation.
interpretation.if_pi05_does_not_improve: The replanning-horizon explanation is weakened and action-response, noise sensitivity, normalization, and adaptation strategy should be investigated next.
